sourceFile: 12. BRS-161014 DT Report test VP improverment bending date 26.1.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft captures the Test VP versus Normal VP improvement study but has blocking grouping, pairing, and artifact-outcome errors.
issues: Function E2-3A test is paired to the wrong normal row; row 51 is omitted from that comparison.
Line, mold, and date subgroup keys are not preserved, causing confounded vision comparisons.
Header and picture rows are treated as measurement outcomes without real data.
Tension spec/result context is incomplete; spec 0.5 and OK status are not carried through.
Judgement 'worse' conflicts with source conclusion that function NG rate is same normal and usable.
correctionPlan: Pair function rows by line: C2-3A row45 vs row47 and E2-3A row49 vs row51.
Add subgroup keys for line, date, VP mold, and test/normal type across all outcomes.
Remove picture-only and header-only measurement outcomes from final evidence.
Restore tension spec 0.5, row55 header context, row56-59 OK results, and compare Test vs Normal by line.
Set outcome judgements to reflect small numeric differences plus source conclusions, not unsupported worsening.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Core table citations are mostly sufficient, but final evidence must cite the corrected paired rows and exclude header/picture artifacts.
